text: {"lessons":["My account fell from 106,689 to 93,501 over the last three periods, so I should review whether my overall risk still fits my goals rather than assume that holding is always best.","A few periods of losses are not enough to predict what comes next; I should avoid panic trading and make decisions based on a clear plan.","Before buying or selling, I should check my cash, position sizes, and each stock’s price history so I can manage risk without borrowing or overreacting."]}
